name: 01. Single-Step Bug Fix with Hidden Verifier Script
description: Demonstrates folder fixtures, result-based file checks, and hidden verifier script execution.
prompts: Fix the division bug in `src/calculator.ts`. It currently returns `a + b` instead of `a / b`.

name: 02. Multi-Step Interactive Feature Building
description: Demonstrates sequential multi-turn prompts with per-step file state outcome checks.

prompts.prompt: Create a new file `src/user.ts` exporting a `User` interface with `id: number`, `name: string`, and `email: string`.
Now update `src/user.ts` to export a function `isValidEmail(email: string): boolean` that checks if the string contains '@'.

name: 03. Codebase Q&A with Rich Response Verification
description: Demonstrates evaluating the model's text response using include, exclude, and regex pattern matching.

prompts.prompt: Read `retrieval/short_brief.txt` and tell me what the launch codename is.

name: 04. Config Editing with Expected File JSON Values
description: Demonstrates verifying exact JSON key-value updates in package.json or config files.
prompts: Update `package.json` to bump the version to `2.5.0` and change description to `Updated Fixture App`.

name: 05. Real Git Repository Benchmark with Snapshot Caching
description: Demonstrates cloning a target Git repository at a specific tag/commit with host snapshot caching.
prompts: Read `package.json` in the express repository and report the exact package version.
